newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weaker, gas oil trims losses.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weaker, gas oil trims losses.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Thursday on a variety of factors, traders said.

Naphtha edged lower waiting for petrochemical demand next month. Cargoes fell about $6 cif NWE to $220/$222 in a quiet market. Gasoline Eurograde barges traded twice at $228 fob ARA, down $7, and unleaded regular started the day off trading at $220 before dipping to $216 and then $218, down $8-9 from Wednesday.
Fuel oil was knocked sharply lower by crude with barges trading at $115-117 fob ARA and cargoes pegged as low as $110 fob NWE.
